name: Hip 90-90 Mobility Stretch
steps: Sit on the floor with your front right leg bent at a 90-degree angle directly in front of you, shin perpendicular to your torso.
Position your rear left leg bent at a 90-degree angle out to the left, shin pointing backward.
Sit as tall as possible with your spine upright, using hands on the floor for balance if necessary.
Gently hinge forward from your hips over your front right shin until you feel a deep stretch in your right outer hip.
Hold for 20 to 30 seconds, sit back upright, switch your legs to the opposite side, and repeat.
coaching_cues: Do not slouch through your lower back; think of leading forward with your sternum.
If your back hip feels pinched, place a yoga block or pillow under your front hip.
Breathe slowly and deeply to encourage tissue relaxation.
